status: SUPERSEDES THE TREE BINDING OF FOUR FILES AND ONE FILE SET, AND DECLARES REL-BD-03 NO LONGER TRUE OF THIS TREE. Edits no register, record or claim text.
decision_ref: Owner decision, working session 2026-10-08: asked where the PicoGK generator should land, the owner chose 'A: Supersede on integration'. The generator was built at the owner's direction ('For the picoGK https://github.com/leap71/PicoGK_Examples'). This record changes a branch only once that branch contains it.
cause: A headless PicoGK 2.3.0 generator for Object 001 replaces the not-implemented stub in geometry/package_picogk. It changes four tree-bound files and adds two source files beside them, and it makes REL-BD-03's statement (Program.cs returns 3; Object001Package.Generate throws; driver.generate reports available=False with or without .NET) false of this tree. The frozen registers are unchanged and still describe the frozen commit, where REL-BD-03 holds.

changed_bound_files.change: The CLI now runs the generator: strict arguments, --voxel-mm, and exit codes 0 (published), 2 (input), 4 (an acceptance check failed; nothing published), 5 (PicoGK native runtime cannot load), 6 (internal error). Candidate.Load refuses duplicate keys and records the candidate's sha256.

Builds the body and lid headless with PicoGK 2.3.0 (new Library(voxel), no viewer), runs the point-probe and STL read-back checks, and publishes body.stl, lid.stl, ports.json and geometry_manifest.json only when every check passes; otherwise writes geometry_rejected.json and keeps the failed parts under rejected/.

Maps the program's exit codes to reasons, and accepts geometry only when the program exits 0 and geometry_manifest.json reports PASSED with sha256 values that match body.stl, lid.stl and ports.json. Without .NET, or on a platform without the PicoGK native runtime, it still reports available=False and runs nothing that fabricates geometry.

Describes the implemented generator, the platforms PicoGK 2.3.0 supports, the exit codes, assumptions A1-A9, the three layers of acceptance checks and what is not established. Supersedes the pin installed by SUP-2026-10-04-01.

claims_superseded.on_this_tree: IMPLEMENTED, NOT OWNER-REVIEWED: the PicoGK Object 001 generator runs where PicoGK 2.3.0 ships native code (osx-arm64 on macOS 26.5 or later, and win-x64). On Linux it refuses with exit code 5 and generates nothing. Every dimension is ENGINEERING-SEED; the layout assumptions A1-A9 are generator choices, not approved designs. No geometry output is committed, and nothing here is an electromagnetic result.

claims_assessed.assessment: NO LONGER HOLDS ON THIS TREE. At the frozen commit it holds unchanged. QmhpCem.Geometry.csproj and __init__.py keep their pins (the csproj at the SUP-2026-10-04-01 digest). REL-BD-01 (openEMS) and REL-BD-02 (planar geometry) are unaffected and are still exercised by the refusal check.

exceptions_assessed.assessment: Spec section 14 items 16 (PicoGK geometry) and 17 (STL, ports and geometry manifest) are implemented on this tree for osx-arm64 and win-x64 only, and are not met on Linux. Item 3 is unchanged: ShapeKernel is not used and SHAPEKERNEL_REVISION stays None. The other items are unchanged.

unchanged: Every other tree-bound digest, every other exact file set, every in-scope record and register, and every claim and exception text. A change to any of them still fails tests/test_release_registers.py.
